0022600098.text: The Detroit Pistons (1-0, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) visit the Miami Heat (0-1, 5th in the Southeast and 14th in the East) for their second game of the season, and Taurean Prince is day-to-day with a personal reason and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Detroit lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2. Their last meeting came on March 8, 2026, in Miami, where the Heat beat the Pistons 121-110 in a regular-season game.
